```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple:
    # Select the closing price series robustly
    if "Close" in df.columns:
        closing_prices = df["Close"].dropna()
    elif "close" in df.columns:
        closing_prices = df["close"].dropna()
    else:
        numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
        if len(numeric_cols) == 0:
            raise ValueError("No numeric column found for closing prices.")
        closing_prices = df[numeric_cols[0]].dropna()

    # Create a single figure with two subplots
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

    # Box plot
    sns.boxplot(y=closing_prices, ax=axes[0], color="skyblue")
    axes[0].set_title("Box Plot of Closing Prices")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("Closing Price")

    # Histogram
    sns.histplot(closing_prices, ax=axes[1], kde=False, color="salmon")
    axes[1].set_title("Histogram of Closing Prices")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Closing Price")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Frequency")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return axes[0], axes[1]
```
